title: Forward incomplete gamma runs finite sums strictly on a < x <= 30, drops ln(10) and x0=31 splits for a <= 20, and loops forward for a > 20
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, the shared forward incomplete-gamma kernel gratio(a, x) removes three splits of NSWC TOMS 708. First, for integer shapes a in 2..=20 and half-integer shapes a in 1.5..=19.5, the finite-sum branch runs strictly on a < x <= 30.0: at x == a Excel runs the lower Taylor series (matched on 42 of 42 adjacent-double boundary calls), and for half-integers Excel evaluates a stored x87 PC64 Horner polynomial over RN53(2^(k+1) / (2k+1)!!) scaled by exp(S(-x - S(0.5 * ln(x)))) * (1 / sqrt(pi)) * x plus ERFC.PRECISE(sqrt(x)). Second, for 1 < a <= 20 outside the finite sums, Excel has no ln(10) switch and no x0 = 31.0 asymptotic switch: x <= a runs the forward Taylor series and x > a stays in the continued fraction down toward DBL_MIN. Third, for a > 20 and x / a >= 1.3 (all x, with no x0 = 31.0 threshold), Excel computes the upper tail by a forward x87-stored loop (amn = S(amn - 1), nt = S(t * S(amn / x)), stopping at |nt| > |t| or |t|/s <= 2^-52) multiplied by S(pm * S(S(a / x) * s)) using poisson_mass(a, x) (Loader's saddle-point prefactor for a > 1 and x > 1.1). See also the DnaCalc last-bit article https://github.com/DnaCalc/DnaCalc/blob/344d70dcea3ea77cbbeee1595f96694630a9610a/docs/articles/last-bit-gamma.md.
basis: Measured across 5,820 cb7 live Excel 16.0.20527 calls and two prospective frozen holdout suites: cb7 frozen_cb7_predictions.jsonl matched 461 of 800 unseen rows (318 of 320 on a > 20, x/a >= 1.3; 240 of 240 for x >= 31) and nx6 frozen_predictions_nx6.jsonl matched 252 of 300 (60 of 60 half-integer forward, 40 of 40 asymptotic forward). Offline across 12 gamma/Poisson/chi witness banks (162,739 rows), landing nx6 moved total matches from 160,287 to 161,032 (+745 net: CHIDIST pinned 120 of 120, POISSON +199, POISSON.DIST +182).
inferred: That Excel executes these exact polynomial, forward-loop, and branch-boundary expressions internally is inferred from the zero-ULP match across frozen holdouts and adjacent-double sweeps; Excel's source was not read.
